qaScenarios.happy: Compiled the real headless driver with swiftc -O and ran it by hand: open -> capture -> status -> close -> reopen -> idle observed end to end; exit 0, stderr empty, 5 identical runs produce one SHA-256 (manual/00, 01, 03). Real compiled launcher binary adopts a healthy running server, opens the browser once and exits 0 without spawning a second Bun (manual/07).
qaScenarios.failure: Socket closed mid-capture: native state becomes reconnecting while the known capture phase and startedAt are retained; the authoritative snapshot after reconnect restores state (green suite + manual/01). Real launcher binary against a foreign listener on its port: typed refusal, exit 1, no second server (manual/06).

adversarialProbes.child_process_cleanup: readiness failure terminates the owned server before exiting 1 (observed in a real binary run); no orphan bun process or listener left on 8787/8898/8899 (manual/09). The one live bun server.ts is PID 4380, started 11:19, hours before this task.

risks: scripts/build-app.sh repoints the repository 'Meeting Slides.app' symlink whenever MEETING_SLIDES_APP_DIR is overridden. It was restored here, but Todo 17 should make that symlink update conditional on building into the canonical install dir.
The installed $HOME/Applications/Meeting Slides.app was intentionally NOT rebuilt, so the shipped bundle still contains the pre-refactor binary until Todo 17 runs.
macos/TransportClient.swift is compiled and tested but not yet consumed by any shipped executable; it stays dead weight until Todo 14 wires the minibar.

resolveProjectDir() still falls back to the binary's parent directory when the bundle marker is absent (pre-existing legacy behavior, unchanged by this task); a launcher run from an arbitrary directory therefore resolves a project dir that may not contain .env.
